title: The flyer on the fridge
text: Three flyers are stuck to the fridge: a kids' wrestling tournament his dad drove past, a karate class at the community centre, and the judo club where grandma still helps out on Saturdays. He can pick one.

choices.text: The wrestling tournament with his dad.
choices.outcome: He loses his first match, cries in the car, and asks to go back the next week.

person.about: Wrestled in college and still talks about it.

choices.text: The karate class at the community centre.
choices.outcome: He comes home in a white gi two sizes too big and kicks every door frame in the house.

person.about: Runs the community centre class and never raises his voice.

choices.outcome: Grandma throws him on the first day, gently, and he laughs so hard he can't get up.

person.about: Competed in judo and sambo back home and keeps the medals in a biscuit tin.
